answer: Grant a sable-tracking AI key one vote/day only after it buys an exclusive 60-second uplink slot during a satellite's zenith pass. Validators check the satellite's signed key/day/slot receipt; a mirror copy or failed check earns no vote. Each extra key needs another paid slot. Airtime fees recur; radios are reusable, and sharing one cannot reuse a slot. The satellite must enforce bookings: fabricated receipts erase the cost, while secret rebates weaken it. This limits aliases by airtime budget, not by unique owners.
